blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Metro Rail Transit 3 (MRT-3) and Light Rail Transit 2 (LRT-2) will offer free rides to children aged 17 and below on Wednesday, November 4, in celebration of National Children’s Month. In separate advisories, the train lines said the free rides can be availed of from 7 a.m. to 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. to 7 p.m. READ: National Children’s Month: Cause for celebration or worry? The train lines said the initiative is in solidarity with the Council for the Welfare of Children in recognizing the importance of children’s lives and well-being.
